description: The Ryu Workflows app: a React Flow DAG canvas (node editing across all kinds, CRUD, versions, run + run-state, triggers, templates, ghost record→replay) shipped as a full-page Companion (Path B, ui_format:"html"). Drives Core's workflow orchestration through the workflows bridge; Connect-owned provider trigger bindings use the same host boundary. Built to one self-contained HTML via vite-plugin-singlefile.
name: @ryu/workflows-app
